title: Diff Mining: Logit Differences Reveal Finetuning Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2608.26462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Finetuning has become the gold standard for refining existing behaviors and inducing new ones in language models, yet it often remains unclear exactly which behaviors emerge during this process. As models grow ever more capable, understanding finetuning better becomes increasingly important, particularly since unwanted behaviors may arise during finetuning. In this paper, we introduce Diff Mining, a simple yet effective framework for identifying what a finetuned model has learned by comparing its logits to those of its base model. Diff Mining effectively surfaces salient tokens that are amplified in the finetuned model, serving as a fingerprint of its training -- even on text unrelated to the finetuning domain. Unlike many existing model diffing methods which require model internals, Diff Mining only needs access to output logits and scales to large models. The framework consists of two modular stages: (i) extracting per-context logit

translated_title: 差异挖掘：逻辑差异揭示微调目标
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.26462v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：微调已成为优化语言模型现有行为和诱导新行为的黄金标准，但在此过程中具体出现了哪些行为往往仍不明确。随着模型能力不断增强，更好地理解微调变得越来越重要，尤其是在微调过程中可能出现不需要的行为。在本文中，我们引入了差异挖掘（Diff Mining），一个简单而有效的框架，通过比较微调模型与其基础模型的逻辑值来识别微调模型学到了什么。差异挖掘有效地表征了微调模型中被放大的显著标记，作为其训练的“指纹”——即使在微调领域无关的文本上也是如此。与许多需要模型内部信息的现有模型差异方法不同，差异挖掘仅需访问输出逻辑值，并能扩展到大型模型。该框架由两个模块化阶段组成：（i）提取每个上下文的逻辑值差异
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“差异挖掘”的简单框架，通过比较微调模型与基础模型的输出逻辑值来揭示微调目标，无需访问模型内部信息，并能有效识别微调过程中学到的行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Diff Mining," a simple framework that reveals finetuning objectives by comparing output logits between a finetuned model and its base model, requiring no internal model access and effectively identifying learned behaviors during finetuning.
